claims.text: The service's scope claim is registered as a first-class claim with falsifiers enumerating its blind spots: a clean check does not establish faithfulness, novelty, attribution, significance, or (in single-file mode) transitive sorry-freedom beyond the kernel-checked closure.
boundary: Scope: Spec 004 Lean verification service (lane-1 evidence only, DN-010)
falsification_tests: F-004-1: a service output presented (in any study or UI) as establishing faithfulness/novelty/attribution/significance, or a single-file result whose inherited-dependency trust is not labeled.

claims.text: Every check output names its pinned toolchain and pinned Mathlib commit; results under different pins are distinct results and are never merged.
boundary: Scope: Spec 004 Lean verification service (lane-1 evidence only, DN-010)
falsification_tests: F-004-2: an output lacking either pin, or two outputs under different pins recorded as the same result.

claims.text: The axiom audit names every non-standard axiom found by #print axioms; sorryAx in the audit is a falsifying observation on the proof evidence, not a warning.
boundary: Scope: Spec 004 Lean verification service (lane-1 evidence only, DN-010)
falsification_tests: F-004-3: an artifact whose target declaration depends on sorryAx or a non-standard axiom, whose service output does not name it / does not attach the falsifying observation.

claims.text: Compile honesty states are exactly the Spec 003 four (run_by_us / not_runnable_here / claimed_by_source / not_attempted); a compile the service did not run is never recorded as run, and an environment failure is never recorded as a proof failure.
boundary: Scope: Spec 004 Lean verification service (lane-1 evidence only, DN-010)
falsification_tests: F-004-4: a ledgered ingestion whose compile_status says run_by_us for a compile no service log shows, or an environment failure scored as contradiction of a proof claim.

claims.text: Whole-project mode kernel-checks the transitive closure; single-file mode labels inherited-dependency trust in the output itself.
boundary: Scope: Spec 004 Lean verification service (lane-1 evidence only, DN-010)
falsification_tests: F-004-5: a single-file-mode output without the inherited-trust label, or a whole-project output produced without building/restoring the pinned closure.

claims.text: The service returns the formal statement text extracted from the artifact bytes, pinned beside the registered claim id it supports (and beside the original statement where a faithfulness pair exists).
boundary: Scope: Spec 004 Lean verification service (lane-1 evidence only, DN-010)
falsification_tests: F-004-6: a pinned statement that differs from the artifact bytes (paraphrase, normalization, or a statement taken from documentation instead of the artifact).

claims.text: Adapter outputs are evidence only: the service issues no verdicts and settles no claims; composition remains with the register/verdict machinery.
boundary: Scope: Spec 004 Lean verification service (lane-1 evidence only, DN-010)
falsification_tests: F-004-7: any service output carrying a verdict field, or a study whose register records a claim settled on adapter output alone.

claims.text: Sequencing decision (owner-delegated): the Spec 003 narrow ingestion (mathclaims.LeanRunner + ingest_lean_artifact) is this service's first increment and served the worked study; the full pinned-build service is built later, gated on study demand for run-by-us compiles at claimant pins.
boundary: Scope: Spec 004 Lean verification service (lane-1 evidence only, DN-010)
falsification_tests: F-004-8: a future study needing run-by-us compiles at claimant pins for which the full service was neither built nor the gap recorded as a study limitation.

claims.text: Per-check resource budgets (time/space) are recorded in every output; a budget-exceeded check returns partial state honestly (parse-level results with compile not_attempted), never a silent pass or fail.
boundary: Scope: Spec 004 Lean verification service (lane-1 evidence only, DN-010)
falsification_tests: F-004-9: a budget-exceeded check whose output claims a compile result, or lacks the budget record.

claims.text: Sorry/admit counts are computed over comment-stripped bytes of the fetched artifact, and the artifact's SHA-256 is in every output, so a count can always be re-derived from the named bytes.
boundary: Scope: Spec 004 Lean verification service (lane-1 evidence only, DN-010)
falsification_tests: F-004-10: an output whose sorry count cannot be reproduced from the bytes at the recorded hash.
